summary: Edge NAT refresh during idle triggers websocket midstream reorder and drops final newline-enabled chunk
description: Issue summary: Multiple customers on Dedicated seats (MapleAI) observed truncated final tokens or missing trailing newlines when a long-lived websocket streaming session becomes idle and a NAT or edge device refresh/rebind occurs. Impact: downstream document generation truncates last sentence; some clients see duplicate fragments when the connection is re-established. Environment: prod us-east-1, dedicated pool id d-34, traffic passes through customer edge + Redwood api-gateway -> edge-proxy -> serving-runtime chain. Observed since 2026-03-09 22:00 UTC after a customer-side firewall update. Noted only for streams > 30s idle with infrequent keepalives. Expected behavior: reconnect handshake or session migration should resume without losing the terminal JSON chunk and without duplicating previously emitted tokens.
steps_to_reproduce: 1) Start a long generation via websocket using model gpt-redwood-2.7b with a prompt that will emit a final newline-terminated paragraph (~350 tokens).
2) Let the stream stay idle for ~35s after last partial tokens are sent (simulate client-side NAT expiry or edge rebind).
3) Trigger a NAT refresh by forcing client IP rebind / toggling wifi briefly to mimic carrier NAT reassign, or run a simulated TCP RST from an upstream firewall.
4) Allow client to reconnect and resume the stream using the existing session token. Observe final chunk behavior and token ordering in client logs.
logs: [2026-03-09T22:12:32Z] serving-runtime: streamed_chunk id=abcd1234 offset=0 size=286 final=false
[2026-03-09T22:12:33Z] serving-runtime: streamed_chunk id=abcd1234 offset=286 size=42 final=true
[2026-03-09T22:12:33Z] client-sdk: received_chunks=[chunk(offset=0), chunk(offset=286)] observed_final=false // missing trailing newline
investigation_notes: Initial hypothesis: NAT/edge rebind is causing a mid-flight TCP close that the gateway interprets as a hard terminal and the resume path is failing to replay a small terminal fragment (single chunk containing final newline + metadata).
Reproducer confirmed with internal loadgen when forcing ephemeral port change on client after idle period > 30s.

Edge proxy (ef-proxy) logs show connection rebind events correlated with missing final newline. In some traces resume sequence shows offsets matching pre-close chunk boundary but client does not receive the terminal delimiter; parser on client therefore treats last JSON choice as incomplete.
Client-side ACK ordering shows a minor reorder in chunk sequence when rebind happens; gap is always on last chunk boundary (final=true on server but not observed by client).

Nagle/Coalesce suspected: small final fragment may be coalesced into TCP FIN sequence which is lost on rebind; gateway resume logic currently assumes whole-chunk atomicity and doesn't re-emit last 8-16 bytes when resume_offset equals chunk end.
No evidence of corruption in serving-runtime; all chunks are recorded in storage and present in runtime logs. Problem appears in the handoff between ef-proxy and api-gateway session resume logic.
comments: 2026-03-10 09:12 - Support (Sofia Chen): Customer reports ~1-2% of long-running websockets missing final newline which breaks downstream JSON parsing. Provided SDK logs and sample trace ids.
2026-03-10 11:04 - SRE (Aisha Patel): Captured ef-proxy trace for session maple-user-71; saw connection rebind at TCP layer. Opening investigation with api-gateway owners.

2026-03-10 14:22 - API Team (Evan Brooks): Confirmed resume path does not force re-emit last 16 bytes when resume_offset matches recorded chunk_end; working on a patch to conservatively re-send trailing partial fragment when reconnect is detected.

2026-03-11 08:30 - Customer (MapleAI - ops@maple.ai): Able to reproduce with our QA harness; impact is primarily a downstream parse error in our ingestion pipeline. We can accept a client-side workaround to add tolerance for missing trailing newline but prefer server-side fix.
2026-03-11 13:56 - Support (Sofia Chen): Raised incident communication to customer; ETA for patch included below.
resolution: Workaround: Customer updated client to treat missing trailing newline as valid end-of-stream for 24h window; deployed parsing fallback. Fix: API gateway patch merged to ensure on resume, if resume_offset == recorded_chunk_end, gateway will retransmit up to 64 bytes of trailing data or the final chunk marker. Patch PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/4523. Deployed to staging 2026-03-12; running A/B on dedicated cluster d-34. Full rollout scheduled after 48h of no regressions.
follow_up_tasks: 1) Instrument keepalive heuristics: add metric for idle-time-to-rebind events and correlate with missing-final-chunk rate (assigned to SRE).
2) Update client SDK docs with guidance on tolerant JSON parsing for streaming outputs (DX team).
3) Add integration test that simulates NAT rebind and asserts final chunk delivery (runtime test-suite).
4) Evaluate whether to change default keepalive interval for dedicated pools behind NAT-prone edges.
